infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Shapiro uses the camera during active study blocks to capture notes and whiteboards into your isolated Study Vault.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Shapiro accesses your photo library only when you explicitly export your Study Vault photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Shapiro saves exported Study Vault photos into subject albums when you request an export.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Shapiro to use the camera during active study blocks to capture notes into your isolated Study Vault.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Shapiro to access your photo library when exporting Study Vault albums.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Allow Shapiro to save exported Study Vault photos to your Camera Roll.
